I reciprocate with a ‘love you too ma’ but the constant pandering was a little much for me. This issue arose again recently. Ma and her husband went on a mini break for five days. Honestly I don’t think I was being an arsehole, just that my mum needs to cut the apron strings a little. But I await my judgement!
